Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's five main topic areas — AI coding assistants, prompting strategies, prototyping workflows, evaluation, and ethical considerations — with subtopics listed under each, serving as a navigational blueprint for the module's content.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: Lists and briefly describes the topics covered in Module 5, including AI coding assistants, their role in HCI design and development workflows, and appropriate use cases, giving learners and instructors a navigable overview of what the module will address.

Artifacts.Name: AI_Assisted_Design
Artifacts.Description: A printable HTML document covering AI-accelerated prototyping workflows, detailing key practices for moving from wireframes to interactive prototypes using AI tools, intended for learners to read, study, or print as a standalone reference on that topic.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to AI Coding Assistants in HCI
Artifacts.Description: This reading introduces AI coding assistants in the HCI context, explaining what they are, how they bridge the gap between design concepts and working prototypes, and why learners should understand them as part of modern interface development practice.

Artifacts.Name: Effective Prompting Strategies for Design Tasks
Artifacts.Description: This reading teaches learners how to write effective prompts when using AI assistants for design and development tasks, covering how prompt quality affects output and strategies for crafting specific, well-structured requests that yield usable results.

Artifacts.Name: AI-Accelerated Prototyping Workflows
Artifacts.Description: This reading describes how AI tools can accelerate the prototyping workflow in HCI, walking learners through how to move from early concepts to interactive, testable prototypes more efficiently by integrating AI assistance into iterative design stages.

Artifacts.Name: Maintaining Design Quality in AI-Assisted Projects
Artifacts.Description: This reading addresses how to maintain design quality when using AI-assisted workflows, examining the risks of uncritical AI output acceptance and covering strategies learners and practitioners can use to review, validate, and uphold professional design standards.

Artifacts.Name: Ethical Considerations and Professional Responsibility
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers the ethical responsibilities and professional obligations that arise when using AI coding assistants and generative tools in HCI work, including issues related to training data, transparency, bias, and accountability in AI-assisted design decisions.
